title: Presentation of an invariant-section orbit ringed space
statement: Let $X$ be a locally ringed space and let $G$ be a group acting by locally ringed space automorphisms $\rho:G\to\operatorname{Aut}(X)$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. An invariant-section orbit ringed space presentation consists of a ringed space $Y$, a ringed-space morphism $q:X\to Y$, and a homeomorphism $e:|Y|\simeq |X|/G$, where the orbit set has the quotient topology, such that $e(q(x))=[x]$ for every $x$, $q\circ\rho(g)=q$ for every $g$, and, for every open $T\subseteq Y$, the section map $q_T^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y(T)\to\mathcal O_X(q^{-1}T)$ is injective with image exactly the sections fixed by pullback under every $g\in G$. The restrictions are those of $\mathcal O_X$ under these injections. This defines the data and their compatibility conditions; it does not choose a presentation from an existence assertion.
